questions.de: Die Flagge welches Staates ist gelb und weiß und zeigt zwei gekreuzte goldene Schlüssel, von denen schon im Neuen Testament die Rede war?
questions.en: Which state's flag is yellow and white and shows two crossed golden keys that are already mentioned in the New Testament?

timeline.labelEn: Pope Pius VII adopts yellow and white as the papal colours, today those of the Vatican flag
timeline.labelDe: Papst Pius VII. führt Gelb und Weiß als päpstliche Farben ein, die heutigen Farben der Vatikanflagge

questions.notes: Strictly, the keys of Saint Peter are shown as one gold and one silver key (Matthew 16:19). The Holy See's flag is identical.

timeline.labelEn: The Beatles record the high-pitched dog tone and run-out groove that end the Sgt. Pepper album
timeline.labelDe: Die Beatles nehmen den hohen Hundeton und die Auslaufrille am Ende des Albums Sgt. Pepper auf

source.title: Sgt. Pepper Inner Groove – The Paul McCartney Project

questions.notes: McCartney (1967 and 2008) and George Martin credit the idea to McCartney, a message 'for Martha' (his sheepdog) and all dogs; en.wikipedia 'A Day in the Life' instead says the tone was suggested by Lennon. The tone follows the song on the LP rather than being part of it. Recording date from en.wikipedia.
